title: Lane and DA Budgets
summary: The combined constraints governing how much transaction work and DA sampling a slot may perform. Lane TEU budgets default to ~20,000 TEU/s per lane, while DA budgets limit signatures per public data space (6-16 range) with a total cap of 2,048 samples. These budgets ensure predictable performance with DA verification under 300ms and lane proof verification under 200ms.
